sources.title: GitHub - ornith-ai/Ornith-1 · GitHub
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.0 ships as a dense 9B model plus two Mixture-of-Experts models (35B, 397B). All checkpoints expose the same OpenAI-compatible interface and support a 256K (262,144-token) context window; the dense 9B fits on a single 80GB GPU, while the MoE checkpoints are sharded across a multi-GPU node with tensor parallelism.

sources.title: Ornith-1.0 35B - 262k context, open source | LLM Reference
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.0 35B MoE is the mid-tier public MoE variant of DeepReinforce's Ornith 1.0 family. Post-trained with self-scaffolding RL for agentic coding, this variant balances MoE inference efficiency with strong coding performance. Supports OpenAI-compatible tool calls. Context: 262,144 tokens confirmed by the official Hugging Face model card and serving config.
